ctx.x: I'll make a note on here that we're interviewing Mr. Earl Foster, this is Bill Russell, and Ralph Collins is here, and also Mr. Harold Dajon. And the date is March the 22nd, 1961. What is the address here? 3212 Borough. Do you mind giving your full name, Mr. Foster?
